description: Source code for an Odoo report parser class 'product_pricelist' that generates product price list reports, including methods for retrieving prices, categories, and formatting data.

classes.name: product_pricelist
classes.description: A report parser class for generating product price list reports in Odoo.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the report parser with context and setting up local context functions.

methods.name: _get_titles
methods.description: Generates a list of title dictionaries based on quantity form inputs.

methods.name: _set_quantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity list based on form input quantities.

methods.name: _get_pricelist
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a pricelist given its ID.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Retrieves the currency name associated with a given pricelist ID.

methods.name: _get_categories
methods.description: Organizes products into categories and retrieves product details with prices based on quantities.

methods.name: _get_price
methods.description: Calculates and formats the price of a product from a pricelist for a given quantity.
